remaining_gaps: The registered original text of 25 FR 1089 (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10860.txt) is the whole Federal Register page and carries front matter whose OCR misreads EO 10860 as 'EO 1086-Q' (Codification Guide entry for EO 10823). Every claim quote cut from that source, including original_representation.quote, is reported by the actual checker as order_exists:out_of_universe_number_in_verbatim_quote (pass_with_unverified), which fails strict completion, and the original_representation quote cannot be shortened by a producer. Legally the order looks operative: sections 1 to 4 have no term, section 5 only fixes the effective date (1960-07-04) and supersedes EO 10823, and no later instrument was found.

The order has 16 dossier clauses (sections 1 to 6 and their subsections) and 21 or more direct amending provisions in held orders (EO 11334, 11808, 11977, 12013, 12164, 12188, 12403, 12567, 12647, 12766, 13118 and others; the packet chain lists 55 events, 25 of them shown in the view), with the FRDOC E6-10451 partial-end candidate dated 2006-07-05 being a State Department delegation that cites EO 12163, not EO 11269. Attributing each amendment to its clause, and deciding whether the amendments that delete or replace words (for example EO 12403, 12567, 12647 and 12766 deleting named institutions) end any clause, requires a consolidated or current text of EO 11269 as amended; the packet carries no custody-verified current record for it (the U.S. Code CURRENT records are custody_record_only), and this producer did not complete the clause-by-clause reconciliation. Needed: a held consolidated text of EO 11269 as amended through 2026-10-14, or each amending order read against the section it changes.

Whether each of the order's amendments to Executive Order 12163 survived to 2026-10-14 cannot be decided without a consolidated text of EO 12163 sections 1-201(a), 1-301 and 1-801. The held U.S. Code note to 22 U.S.C. 2381 note (CURRENT:EO:12458#0) prints only the list of amending orders, not the sections. Later held orders renumber and rewrite the targets: EO 12560 (1986-05-24, 51 FR 19159) redesignates paragraphs of section 1-201(a) and restates section 1-301(c) to read in full (keeping the words 'except chapters 4, 6, and 8 thereof'), EO 12608 (1987-09-09) revokes paragraphs (23) and (24) of section 1-201(a) and renumbers (25) to (28), and EO 12738 (1990-12-14), EO 13091 (1998-06-29) and EO 13118 (1999-03-31) redesignate and rewrite further paragraphs and Part 1-1. Which paragraphs of 1-201(a) carry EO 12458's three insertions (the section 512 FAA-RP 1982 item, chapter 8 of Part II, and the Public Law 98-151 item) at each stage, and whether sections 1-301(a) and 1-801(b) and (c) still read as EO 12458 amended them, require the successive paragraph numbers of the target sections, which the held texts give only as relative instructions. Needed: a held consolidated or current text of EO 12163 (or each amending order read paragraph by paragraph); this producer did not complete that reconstruction.

The state of five offices listed in section 1 on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided from held evidence: section 1(i) (Research and Innovative Technology Administration), 1(j) (Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation), 1(k) (Regional Administrator, Southern Region, Federal Aviation Administration), 1(l) (Director, Resource Center, Lakewood, Colorado, Federal Highway Administration) and 1(m) (Regional Administrator, Northwest Mountain Region, Federal Aviation Administration) are named offices of the Department of Transportation that may have been renamed, merged or abolished after 2009. No held statute, reorganization notice or Department of Transportation document shows whether each office existed or was succeeded on 2026-10-14; a clause listing an office that no longer exists cannot be carried as operative without that source. Needed: held current statutory or regulatory text (for example the current Department of Transportation organization provisions of 49 U.S.C. chapter 1 and 49 CFR part 1, or an FAA and FHWA reorganization notice) stating the existence or succession of each of these five offices. The held 49 CFR part 1 sections in jobs/theophilus-sources (1.27, 1.38, 1.38a, 1.45, 1.74, 1.81, 1.97) do not name them.

The packet holds no current-law record for this order (the U.S. Code search records one hit, the eCFR search none, and no CURRENT: record is in the packet's citable evidence); the order's own held text shows no end and no later instrument amends or revokes it, which would support the offices in section 1(a) to (h) and sections 2 to 4 but cannot decide the five offices above.

Section 6 directs the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, within 14 days of the order (deadline 2025-05-07), to terminate the Historically Black Colleges and Universities and Minority Serving Institutions Advisory Council. No held source shows that the Administrator did terminate the council or when; a search of the held texts for the council's name finds only the order's own texts and the 20 U.S.C. 1060 note that reprints the order, and EO 14354 (continuance of certain Federal advisory committees) and FR Doc. 2025-18033 do not name the council. A deadline is not an end, and whether the command was performed is not established, so the clause can be carried neither as operative nor as terminated with an exact first end. Needed: a held EPA charter-termination record, Federal Register notice or other dated EPA document showing the termination of that advisory council.

The remaining clauses of EO 14283 (the White House Initiative, the President's Board of Advisors on HBCUs, accountability and general provisions) are supported by the held 20 U.S.C. 1060 note and EO 14354 (2025-09-29), which continues the Board, so only section 6's second sentence blocks a submission; the first sentence of section 6 (revocation of Executive Order 14041) was performed on issuance.
